title: The W3 Total Cache plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in…
description: The W3 Total Cache plugin for WordPress up to and including version 2.10.7 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'comment' parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping when HTML Minify is enabled with the default 'mfunc' entry in the ignored-comment stems list. Exploitation requires an attacker to predict a time-based placeholder namespace by reading the server clock from the HTTP Date header. Successful exploitation allows injection of arbitrary scripts that execute when users access the affected pages.
